title: Mahjarrat Memories (miniquest)
start: Talk to Kharshai via the trapdoor in Thorvald the Warrior's helmet shop in Rellekka.

items.t: 7,500 vibrant memories (or memories of a higher tier); enriched memories count for double (collected during miniquest)
Macaw pouch or Ravenous locust pouch (for Zemouregal's memory)

recommended.t: Nightmare muspah familiar (makes the process more AFK and provides an increased chance for enriched memories as well as a chance to gather more energy, at least 2 needed for the duration of the quest)
Elder divination outfit or its equivalents (if owned)
Ethereal Connection (World Gate engram) buff from Memorial to Guthix
Enchanted lyre, Fremennik sea boots 4 or activated Fremennik Province lodestone for quick Rellekka teleport
Divine-o-matic vacuum (works for filling charges instead of gathering energy, might be profitable or not depending on type of energy–will take longer because divine-o-matic destroys memories)
Divination cape (if owned, makes the process more afk)

rewards.t: 375,000 Divination XP (given during the miniquest; 25,000 Divination XP is awarded each time a memory is turned in)
An engrammeter that Kharshai states could be useful in Freneskae when charged
Dr Nabanik's Old Trilby cosmetic override

steps.t: Speak to Kharshai, located under the helmet shop in Rellekka. Agree to help him. [Chat: 3 I want to talk about the Mahjarrat memories. › 1 Tell me more. › Accept › 1 Sign the contract.]
With the engrammeter, head to any divination colony of vibrant wisps or higher. Fill it with 500 divine memories.

sub.t: You may utilise World 79 (Community Divination World) for more frequent enriched springs.

steps.t: Visit the locations below, use the charged engrameter to collect the memory.
Return to Kharshai. Talk to him to give him the memory. [Chat: 3 I want to talk about the Mahjarrat memories.]
Recharge the engrammeter with another 500 divine memories, and repeat for the remaining 14 memories.
Take the final memory to Kharshai, receive your reward.
